messages:
Sam (Support): Escalating to CS P1 1: Nimbus AI trial activation failing, embed provisioning returning 502s and blocking demo prep. They requested urgent help or refund.
Ava (CS): Copy. Can you summarize scope and last successful event? Need to know renewal window.
Sam (Support): Scope: trial seats not activating, ingest webhook returns 502s, retries backoff. Last successful activation seen 2024-11-15T14:12Z. Support ticket NT-9123. Attempts: restarted worker pool, cleared prefix cache, swapped region -> still 502.
Sam (Support): Log snippet: `upstream_status=502 request_id=req_6b2c X-Region=us-east-1` repeated. No deploys from customer.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2024-591 created (severity P1). Pagerduty alerted.
Diego (CS Lead): Assigning owners: Ava = CS owner, Sam = support triage, Kai = SE to investigate routing/edge. CS to draft comms plan.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Running traces now. Quick check shows our fallback route timing out when upstream 502s spike and causing cascades. Test used: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REX_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embed?customer=nimbus"`
Ava (CS): Draft comms: 1) Acknowledge within 30m (Support) 2) Hourly internal updates in this thread 3) Exec note if unresolved in 3h 4) Postmortem + remediation + credits if >2h downtime. Owners?
Diego (CS Lead): I'll coordinate credits with finance if needed. Ava owns customer comms and renewal guardrails. Sam to log every triage action.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Quick mitigation: extend fallback timeout to 8s for this route and enable aggressive retry for Nimbus customer-id. Pushing to staging for smoke now, will canary to prod if passes. Rollback plan ready.
Sam (Support): Staging patch rolled, smoke ETA ~18m. Sharing sanitized headers/log dump to thread.
Ava (CS): Preparing customer note template. Keep plain, include technical contact. Draft: "Hi Nimbus team 1: Weve identified a routing issue causing activation errors. Engineers are deploying a targeted fix and expect improvement within ~30 minutes. We'll update again at {time}. Contact: ava@redwood.ai (CS) and kai@redwood.ai (tech)." Thoughts?
Sam (Support): Looks good, add link to ticket NT-9123 and mention were monitoring.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Staging smoke passed. Canary 5% started 15:53 UTC. Monitoring embed success rate and latencies.
Sam (Support): Canary sample shows errors down ~95% for sampled flows.
Diego (CS Lead): Increase to 50% for 10 minutes, then full on green.
Kai (Solutions Eng): 50% stable for 12 minutes, promoting to full. Monitoring 30m.
oncall-bot: INC-2024-591 status changed to mitigated by automation.
Ava (CS): Sending customer update: apology, what were doing, ETA for full restoration, and contacts. Scheduling enablement session next week to ensure provisioning checklist passes.
Sam (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks 1: seeing improvements, will re-run demo checks. Please confirm when fully resolved."
Diego (CS Lead): Action items: Kai to produce postmortem and RCA, Sam to collate full request logs and intervals, Ava to update renewal risk tracker and schedule enablement + follow-up, Diego to coordinate credits if downtime >2h.
Ava (CS): I'll draft renewal guardrail note to share with AM and document in tracker. Will close handback when postmortem posted.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Postmortem draft ETA 24h, will include long-term mitigation timeline and code references.
Sam (Support): Will keep hourly updates until PPC (postmortem + patch) posted.
Ava (CS): Thanks team. Good coordination. :white_check_mark:
